rules.quote: public int getTransferRate() { return 1000; } public int getMaxSource() { return 1000; }
rules.topic: Sourcelink base stats: internal buffer 1000 source, transfer rate 1000; the alchemical sourcelink overrides transfer rate to 10000, the volcanic sourcelink keeps 1000
Source relay: buffer 1000 source, transfer rate 1000; relays move source between jars and machines but generate nothing

rules.quote: rawMax += ServerConfig.INIT_MAX_MANA.get(); rawMax += numGlyphs * ServerConfig.GLYPH_MAX_BONUS.get(); rawMax += tier * ServerConfig.TIER_MAX_BONUS.get();
rules.topic: Player max mana formula (config defaults): 100 base + 15 per glyph ever unlocked (glyph bonus) + 50 per spell book tier; armor perks and the Mana Boost effect add further (Mana Boost = +25 per level, config default)

rules.quote: regen += numGlyphs * ServerConfig.GLYPH_REGEN_BONUS.get(); regen += tier * ServerConfig.TIER_REGEN_BONUS.get(); regen += ServerConfig.INIT_MANA_REGEN.get();
rules.topic: Player mana regeneration per second (config defaults): 5 base + 0.33 per glyph unlocked + 1 per book tier; the Mana Regen enchantment adds +2 per level per second, the mana regen potion +10 per level

Volcanic sourcelink: once per second it consumes one item entity within 1 block (or one item from a surrounding arcane pedestal) and converts it to source by the item's volcanic source value; an item is only partially consumed when the link cannot hold its full value and the buffer is non-empty

rules.quote: public static SpellTier ONE = createTier(new ResourceLocation(ArsNouveau.MODID, "one"), 1);
rules.topic: Spell tiers are values 1, 2, 3 (creative = 99); glyphs belong to a tier and a caster's book tier gates which glyph tiers and how many glyphs a spell may use (glyph-limit enforcement is a server config, default on)
Holding a higher-tier spell book permanently raises the player's book tier (it never decreases from holding a weaker book); the tier feeds max mana (+50 per tier) and regen (+1 per second per tier)

Enchanting apparatus recipes carry an explicit source cost in their data; example defaults: applying Mana Regen I costs 2000 source, Mana Regen II costs 3500 source (datagen = shipped defaults; datapacks may override)
All mana economy numbers (base max, per-glyph, per-tier, regen) are server config values under the 'mana' section; quoted numbers are the shipped defaults and a configured server may differ
